exposure: low amniotic fluid index before delivery
Mode of delivery (cesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
cohort: 424 full-term newborns with meconium-stained amniotic fluid during delivery
finding: Low amniotic fluid index before delivery, advanced gestational age, cesarean section, severe amniotic fluid contamination, low umbilical cord blood pH, and low neonatal Apgar 1-minute score were identified as influencing factors for MAS in full-term neonates.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with an increased risk of MAS in full-term neonates with meconium-stained amniotic fluid.
